title: Instantiation of dictionaries in resources with resource_local_to_scene set to true fail
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot 4.5 dev 5, but not in earlier versions.

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev5 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7216) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12600K (16 threads)

### Issue description

In Godot 4.5 dev 5 it looks like resources that are properties of nodes in Packed scenes do not properly initialize the dictionaries.

When instantiating a node with a localized resource, it appears that the node will no longer initialize dictionaries in the resource. This issue only appears to affect dictionaries in the resource at this time, but I may have missed other problems.

   b_local:  4

---------------------

=========ARRY=========
Num Entries : 4

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new custom resource in a gdscript file and add an exported dictionary.
2. Create a new resource with the custom type and set the `resource_local_to_scene` to true
3. Add the resource to a node in a packed scene.
4. Instantiate the packed scene.

[mrp_dictionary_issue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20618912/mrp_dictionary_issue.zip)
